title: Routed GeGLU experts over a GGUF's stored expert blocks
description: The experts slot for a mixture of experts whose routed experts a GGUF stores as fused [experts][2 * inter][hidden] gate|up and [experts][hidden][inter] down tensors in its block formats (IQ3_S, IQ4_NL, IQ4_XS, Q8_0): a layer's experts stay as their stored rows on the device or in pinned host memory (load_layer, where the placement plan puts them); forward decodes only the experts a call routes to (gguf-projections' decoders, bit for bit gguf-py's), each in BF16, multiplies each expert's tokens padded to 8 rows (a decode row's bits its own whatever rows share the call) with FP32 accumulation, applies the activation's GLU (gelu_tanh by default: Gemma 4's GeGLU; silu for SwiGLU) and sums each token's routes in route order, FP32 out.

group.description: experts decoded at once in a call that routes to more

prompt.description: prompt rows' activations: the stored GGUF formats' own (int8 units of 32 with an FP32 scale, the int8 tensor cores straight from the blocks), FP8 with row-wise scales, or BF16

decode.description: decode rows' activations: the stored GGUF formats' own (int8 units of 32 with an FP32 scale, integer dot products), or BF16 with every weight decoded to FP32
